rationale: The weakest-link certification is internally consistent with the stated hypothesis and pairs two legs whose archive evidence appeared on different metrics (cash-flow leg on the FMB slope, maturity leg on alpha), so it is a substantive rather than cosmetic extension of SustainedResearchFloorCashBacked — though it inherits that signal's ~9% coverage and must beat its already-strong 0.445 Sharpe to be informative.

Structurally identical to the preceding proposal with net working capital replacing near-term maturities, and the two certifications it MINs (operating cash flow and net working capital) are much more economically correlated than the cash/maturity pair, so the "clean design test" framing is fair but the incremental information content is thin.

Obligation-scaled profitability is an untested normalization with a genuine coverage gain, but ib/lt is close to a mechanical product of ROA and inverse leverage — both already represented in the archive — and the unwinsorized ratio will be dominated by low-liability firms even after IND_RANK.

A clean, internally consistent continuous variable that fills the untested 2x2 cell (trough evaluation × current-asset-excluded denominator), but the outcome is largely predictable from the two archived legs and the five-year minimum of a restated ROA is in practice a "never had a loss year" screen, which overlaps existing profitability/loss-persistence effects.

This reuses the exact ingredients of gen-7's UnearnedIntangibleBookWeakCoverage (goodwill/intangible book, oancf/lt coverage, retained earnings) with only the aggregation changed from additive to MIN, so it is a cosmetic reconfiguration, and low retained earnings plus weak cash coverage is a well-known distress/O-score composite rather than an acquisition-accounting mechanism.

This is the first dynamic (growth-race) certification paired with the research-commitment floor rather than another level-of-quality leg, and the sign logic is coherent; the main construction risk is that GROWTH of a three-year cumulative cash flow is ill-behaved when the base crosses zero, which could inject sign-flipping noise into the certification rank.
